relationship.original_equation: Constant-currency revenue growth = current revenue translated at prior-period exchange rates / prior revenue − 1
relationship.locator: Full Year Highlights footnote 2; Operating Review revenue table and footnote 2
relationship.translation_notes: Both inputs are same-currency monetary flows and the output is a base-one growth fraction.

assumptions: Current revenue is translated at the relevant prior-period rates and aggregates consistently with the prior-period reporting basis.
Both amounts cover comparable entities, activity scope, measurement periods and reporting currency; prior revenue is positive.
limitations: This formula consumes a separately restated current-period figure; it does not itself construct the currency translation.
Other issuers may instead restate the prior period at current rates or adjust for acquisitions and divestitures, so definitions are not interchangeable.
Constant-currency growth is an alternative performance measure and does not eliminate other comparability changes.
